title: mini foil cupcake liners
text: mini foil cupcake liners. I purchased these for a spring bridal high tea.  I am gonna make mini pecan pralines and put them in these colorful foil liners.  I wish there had been some pastel spring colors, but these are BRIGHT - mostly primary colors - also black, rose gold, silver and regular gold.  Shiny, metallic looking foil (as you would expect) liners.  400 of them.  I will use 16.  Haha.  Maybe I'll use the red and green at Christmas for fudge.  Lots of them.  They also appear to be pretty sturdy.  I opened the package up to check the thickness.  The stack of 400 is less than 5" long... I haven't counted, so I am trusting there are 400 in there!
